subject: Copywriting
title: Algorithmic Amplification
description: A quick win: understand Algorithmic Amplification.

hook.text: Facebook's algorithm promotes content that generates strong reactions. Anger gets 6x more engagement than joy.

buildup.text: Algorithms don't create propaganda—they amplify it. The most provocative messages reach the most people automatically.

discovery.text: A 2021 study found that adding angry emojis to a post increased its reach by 5x.

twist.text: The algorithm is a propagandist without ideology.

climax.text: When the distribution system optimizes for engagement over truth, propaganda no longer needs a propagandist.

punchline.text: Anger gets 6x more engagement. Algorithms are propaganda on autopilot.

quiz.question: How much more engagement does anger get compared to joy on Facebook?
